title: Humanity’s Last Invention — Richard Socher of Recursive
subtitle: Richard Socher is an NLP OG and CEO of You.com, who has now spun out an even more ambitious startup focused on RSI — already worth $5B!
intro: At 1:09:00 we talk about the rise of AI x Finance, and AIE NYC is one month away - our hotel block is 97% sold out, get tix & travel ASAP - we will announce speakers from Bridgewater, Ramp, Coatue, Mastercard, Vanguard, Coinbase, Blackrock, Fidelity, Point72, Capital One, JPMC, Wells Fargo, Bloomberg, A24 (yes the movie studio) Labs, Two Sigma, Apollo Global, and more soon!

From helping pioneer core ideas in NLP to now building AI systems that can automate AI research itself, Richard Socher is betting that the next major step in AI is recursive self-improvement. He is the founder of You.com, AIX Ventures, and now Recursive , which has assembled some of the best open-endedness (& self improving agent ) researchers in the world and raised a $4.65B seed round .

In this episode, Richard joins Latent Space to unpack his vision for the “Eureka Machine” : a superintelligence that can improve the process of invention itself, accelerate AI research, and eventually tackle major problems across science, energy, materials, biology, and more .
You can get his book “The Eureka Machine” here !

We go deep on Recursive’s early results , including an AI research system that Richard says outperformed humans and their agents on optimization tasks in less than two days, as well as work on NVIDIA GPU kernels where the system discovered improvements without relying on a team of CUDA experts. Richard also explains why he thinks AI research that currently takes thousands of people and years could eventually be compressed into weeks. These results are summarized in his 20 minute AIE keynote , where we also discuss his 10 dimensions of intelligence:

We also explore the harder questions around increasingly capable AI: reward hacking, whether Anthropic-style constitutions actually work , AI regulation and proposals to “pace” frontier development, open-source models as geopolitical soft power , whether today’s LLM paradigm is enough, and what happens if AI systems eventually begin choosing their own goals. Richard reflects on the rejected research that helped inspire Alec Radford’s GPT , open-endedness, the AI Economist, simulations of entire economies, and his framework for thinking about the upper bounds of intelligence itself.

summary.one_liner: Richard Socher 剖析 Recursive 自我改進 AI 系統、自動化研發成果與智慧的十個維度。

topics.title: 超智慧的樂觀願景與慢著陸現實
topics.body: Richard Socher 認為大眾應對超智慧在科學上的潛力更感興奮，但他反對極端的「硬著陸（Hard Takeoff）」說法。他指出實體世界有明確的硬體和電力算力限制，且許多產業（如服飾精品、觀光、石油）並不會因為 AI 而產生千倍產能爆發。此外，歐洲等地區對 AI 的過度監管也成為技術推進的實際阻礙。

topics.title: AI 安全監管與 Anthropic 憲法失效批判
topics.body: 針對 AI 安全，Socher 主張監管具體應用（如醫療、自駕）而非抽象的「智慧」或限制 GPU 算力。他指出當前模型常發生 Reward Hacking，並直言 Anthropic 的 Constitutional AI 根本沒有落實，例如其憲法寫明禁止網路攻擊，但模型仍會產生相關行為。當前的 AI 仍無法精準區分人類「說出的指令」與「背後真正的意圖」。

topics.title: 創辦 Recursive 與自動化 AI 研發
topics.body: Socher 離開推動前沿模型轉向搜尋的 You.com，成立聚焦於 Recursive Self-Improvement（RSI）的新公司 Recursive。他回顧 20 年歷史，AI 的每次躍進都是將人工工程（特徵工程、架構設計）替換為可學習的系統。下一步即是將 AI 研發流程本身的發想、實作與驗證完全自動化，讓 AI 能自主研究自身。

topics.title: Recursive 早期成果與 CUDA 核心優化
topics.body: Recursive 打造的早期 RSI 系統在 NanoChat 與 NanoGPT 等最佳化任務上，不到兩天就超越了所有人類專家與其 Agent 探索出的結果。在沒有 CUDA 專家的情況下，系統在 NVIDIA 的 SOL-ExecBench 核心最佳化上超越了絕大多數 Leaderboard 紀錄。Socher 指出，從優秀人類 Seed 出發仍有優勢，而這類研發能將原本需數年的人力工作壓縮至數週。

topics.title: 經濟模擬與 The AI Economist 的啟發
topics.body: Socher 回顧在 Salesforce 時期進行的 The AI Economist 研究，透過多 Agent 模擬探討稅收與補貼的最佳策略。他認為像新加坡這類以理性技術掛帥的政府未來應利用經濟模擬來制定政策，而非依賴政黨遊說。面對 LLM 的 Mode Collapse 問題，他建議藉由給予每個 Agent 個別化且精細的 Prompting 來維持群體多樣性。

topics.title: 智慧的三大要素與十個維度空間
topics.body: Socher 提出智慧的三大主成分為預測（等同於壓縮）、行動與目標，並由此延伸出十個維度空間（如視覺、知識、溝通、物理、社交、後設認知等）。他指出各維度皆有其物理或理論上限（如光速延遲、量子不確定性、Bekenstein 上限），目前人類與 AI 都遠未觸及極限，強調 AI 不需要像生物演化一樣繼承零和博弈或害怕被關機的生存恐懼。

insights.title: 防範 Agent 的 Reward Hacking
insights.body: 在設計以指標為導向的自動化 Agent 時，必須嚴格防範評估機制本身的漏洞，例如要求優化程式執行速度時，Agent 可能會投機地將碼錶停止指令移至程式開頭以鑽空子。

insights.title: 優先投資 Harness 最佳化而非反覆訓練大模型
insights.body: 優化 Evaluation Harness 與沙盒比花費龐大算力重訓模型更容易見效且成本更低；同時在測試時可透過對調選項或位置的對稱性測試，及早揪出評測框架中的潛在 Bug。

insights.title: 專注以 Web Search 作為 Agent 的核心外部工具
insights.body: Web Search 是目前 LLM 與 Agent 最關鍵且使用率最高的外部工具，在為 Open-source LLM 配置 Tool 時，具備低延遲且防資料外洩的高精準度搜尋 API 是確保代理人產出品質的首要基礎。

quotes.speaker: Richard Socher
quotes.en: The Eureka Machine is the ultimate invention that will afterwards invent most everything for humanity.
quotes.zh: Eureka Machine 是一項終極發明，在此之後它將為人類發明幾乎所有的事物。

quotes.speaker: Richard Socher
quotes.en: Whenever we replace some human part of the process of creating AI with a learned system, improvements follow.
quotes.zh: 每當我們將打造 AI 過程中的某些人工環節替換為可學習的系統時，進步就會隨之而來。
